sub_sector.value: Lifestyle footwear; performance athletic footwear; outdoor footwear

product_category.detail: UGG lifestyle footwear, apparel, accessories and homewares, HOKA performance footwear and apparel, and Teva versatile footwear.

market_position.detail: UGG emphasizes quality and craftsmanship, HOKA offers premium performance footwear and apparel, and Teva emphasizes accessibility.

distribution_model.detail: Sells through retail partners and directly to consumers, including through company-owned UGG concept and outlet stores.

purchase_frequency.detail: Consumers buy lifestyle boots, performance footwear, apparel and homewares on a discretionary basis.

notes: Purchase frequency is inferred from the product mix.
